name: com.rivalsweeper/signals
title: RivalSweeper Signals
description: 39 eCommerce competitor-intel tools: prices, promos, ads, AI visibility. Plan-included or prepaid.

tools.name: check_brand_data_coverage
tools.description: Check which competitive signals RivalSweeper has for an eCommerce domain, with per-signal freshness (for prices: when a price was last read, plus the share of priced products read in the last 7 days; records counts products, each product once however many variant rows it has; for large catalogs these come from a sample and are marked records_approximate). A signal is available exactly when its tool has data: promotions counts the live offers get_active_promotions_and_coupons returns, prices follow get_brand_price_statistics. Free and non-billable.

tools.name: get_active_promotions_and_coupons
tools.description: Active promotions/discount codes for a brand: code, discount, terms, valid_until. Only live offers (expired and single-use codes left out). Each row says how it is known: verification = seen_on_brand_homepage (read off the brand's own homepage) or third_party_unverified (listed on public coupon sites, not tested at checkout), or seen_in_brand_signup_popup (the offer the brand's own sign-up popup or form shows for signing up, plus its event sign-ups such as Black Friday early access; no code is shown for these). Freshness-stamped. Included in RivalSweeper plans (developer API keys: 1 credit, no data = no charge).

tools.name: get_brand_price_statistics
tools.description: Price statistics (min/max/avg/median) plus recent product samples for a brand, optionally filtered by product-name query. Freshness = when a price was last read; stats also give the share of products whose price was read in the last 7 days and the median read time, and a note flags catalogs where most prices are older. Included in RivalSweeper plans (developer API keys: 1 credit, no data = no charge).

tools.name: find_closest_competitor_brands
tools.description: The brand's last-known DNA competitor set: the closest competing brands RivalSweeper identified for a domain, each with name, website, country and match tier, plus the brand's own DNA profile. Freshness-stamped. Included in RivalSweeper plans (developer API keys: 2 credits, no data = no charge).

tools.name: get_homepage_top_links
tools.description: A brand's current homepage top links (up to 10) enriched from its catalog and grouped into Products, Categories and Content, in that order. Per link: title, vendor, price + compare-at/on-sale, currency, stock status, URL status (active/inactive), review rating, homepage position, anchor text and last update. A top-level 'comment' flags when pricing and/or stock status are not captured for the domain. Included in RivalSweeper plans (developer API keys: 2 credits, no data = no charge).

tools.name: get_ai_agent_readiness_score
tools.description: RivalSweeper 6-pillar AI/agent-readiness score for a domain (schema.org, technical access, content quality, trust, AI-specific, entity recognition) with tier and highlights. Uniquely RivalSweeper data. Included in RivalSweeper plans (developer API keys: 1 credit, no data = no charge).

tools.name: get_full_brand_snapshot
tools.description: Bundle: all current signals for one brand-day - promotions, price stats + samples, AI-readiness - in one call. Included in RivalSweeper plans (developer API keys: 15 credits, no data = no charge).

tools.name: get_my_usage_and_plan
tools.description: Your own account status. Signed in with RivalSweeper: your plan, tool calls used this month vs. the plan limit, and the domains you can query. Developer API key: prepaid credit balance plus calls and credits per tool over a look-back window (default 30 days). Free; only ever returns your own usage.

tools.name: get_significant_competitor_changes
tools.description: Recent significant changes for a competitor: price drops/increases >10% (one alert per product, variants folded; a return to full price after a markdown is labelled promo_ended, not an increase), new promotions, stock-status flips. Returns a chronological alert feed with a summary. Configurable window (1-90 days, default 7). Included in RivalSweeper plans (developer API keys: 2 credits, no data = no charge).

tools.name: request_missing_data_signal
tools.description: Tell RivalSweeper exactly what signal you need for a domain. For a signal that is missing for a domain or that RivalSweeper does not track yet. We prioritize data collection based on demand. Free and non-billable.

note.description: Optional context: what you plan to do with this data

tools.name: request_new_brand_monitoring
tools.description: Add a rival domain to monitoring. Signed in with RivalSweeper: adds it to your monitored rivals right away (company Admins only; your plan or trial domain limit applies), with first data within about 24h. Developer API keys: queues a monitoring request (needs a positive prepaid balance; first data in 24-72h). Free.

tools.name: list_my_tracked_brands
tools.description: The brands in your RivalSweeper account: your own site(s) and the rival brands you monitor, with status: the domains this connector can answer for.

tools.name: get_cross_channel_ads_overview
tools.description: Cross-channel ads picture (Meta, Google and others) for your brand vs rivals: live and new ads, reach, channel mix, 12 weeks of launches per channel and placement, coordinated pushes, gaps vs you, the Google country matrix, Meta placement concentration, and prioritized insights with suggested actions. Full data, nothing trimmed.

domains.description: Brand domains from your RivalSweeper account, e.g. ["gymshark.com"]. Omit for all your tracked brands.

tools.name: get_meta_ads_reach_messages_and_landing_pages
tools.description: Everything on the app's Meta Ads tab for your brand vs rivals, untrimmed: reach (accounts that saw the ads, UK/EU only) and reach by market, all top ads by reach and by days running plus ended long-runners (full copy, links), hook angles with what each brand tests vs funds, hooks by country with every angle count, the punch of each analysed ad read from the creative itself (image, carousel cards or the whole video with its sound: the idea that stops the scroll, on-screen text, first words spoken, format, references) with context only where a source is linked (calendar event named in the ad, a page about the reference) and what each brand tests vs funds per punch type, offers and codes, CTA mix, formats, languages, creators, new promoters, campaign tags, sites and every promoted page (name, price, stock, category, live ads, reach, broken links). Up to 6 brands per call.

domains.description: Up to 6 brand domains from your RivalSweeper account, e.g. ["esteelauder.com","charlottetilbury.com"]. Omit for your own store plus your first tracked rivals.

sections.description: Optional: return only these parts (everything is returned when omitted). The full answer for several brands is large (about 25k tokens per 2 brands): ask for the sections you need, or fewer brands per call.

tools.name: get_google_ads_shopping_targeting_and_creatives
tools.description: Everything on the app's Google Ads tab for your brand vs rivals, untrimmed: live, new and stopped ads, every country, Google Shopping, formats, targeting, creative freshness (median ad age, weekly series), all topics, where ads show, reach, alerts, advertiser accounts. Name exactly one brand to also get its Google creatives, 200 per page (creatives_offset for the next page; `total` tells how many exist). Up to 6 brands per call.

domains.description: Up to 6 brand domains from your RivalSweeper account. Omit for your own store plus your first tracked rivals. Name exactly one to include its creatives.

country.description: Optional ISO country code to focus on one market, e.g. "DE".

creatives_offset.description: With one brand: skip this many creatives (pages of 200). Default 0.

tools.name: get_brand_radar_assortment_gaps
tools.description: Weekly Brand Radar for your store vs rivals: brands you are missing (white space), where you lead (moat), depth gaps, price position and discount pressure per brand. For multi-brand retailers; returns no data for single-brand stores.

owned_domain.description: Your own store domain, if you have more than one

tools.name: get_homepage_product_shelf_and_markdowns
tools.description: Which products each brand keeps on its homepage and for how long (persistence = share of the observed days on the homepage, slots, best position), with price, currency and markdown, plus the categories it features - a read on what brands are pushing. Window in days (7-365, default 90).

domains.description: Brand domains from your RivalSweeper account, e.g. ["gymshark.com"]. Omit for all your tracked brands.

tools.name: get_bestsellers_by_review_velocity
tools.description: What each brand is actually selling now, read from how fast its products collect reviews (the review widget's own count, deduplicated across colours that share one count): fastest_growing (reviews gained in the window, default 14 days, with the store's own bestseller rank, homepage link, price and stock), new_in_top_5 (products that entered the top 5 vs the window before), launches (first seen in the last 45 days: reviews since first seen and a read: collecting reviews / early / no reviews yet) and selling_but_rated_low (gaining reviews with an average of 3.5 or less). Review growth tracks the store's own bestseller sort on most stores but is not sales: use it as a demand signal. Brands whose review widget we do not read are not_measured. Window 7-90 days.

domains.description: Brand domains from your RivalSweeper account, e.g. ["gymshark.com"]. Omit for all your tracked brands.

tools.name: get_newly_published_products_and_pages
tools.description: Products and pages RivalSweeper first found on each brand's site (sitemaps and catalog feeds) in the last N days, interleaved across brands; per brand new products come first, then products with new sizes/colours, content and other pages, then categories, each newest first. Shopify variant URLs are folded into their product, and a product that only gained new sizes/colours is labelled so. Each item has its tags (names), first_seen (when RivalSweeper first found it: usually within a day of publication, not the brand's own publish date) and sitemap_lastmod when the sitemap gives one; per-brand counts come first. Pages found in a brand's first days of tracking are left out (they existed before). Default last 7 days, up to 50 items (max 200).

domains.description: Brand domains from your RivalSweeper account, e.g. ["gymshark.com"]. Omit for all your tracked brands.

tools.name: get_technology_stack
tools.description: The technology each brand runs, per brand: e-commerce platform first, then payments, cross-border, email/SMS, reviews and loyalty, search and personalisation, customer service, shipping, analytics, advertising, consent/security and infrastructure, each with its category names. Social networks the site links to are listed apart (a profile link is not a tool the store runs). Up to 40 technologies per brand by default (max_per_brand up to 200); the count left out is stated per brand.

domains.description: Brand domains from your RivalSweeper account, e.g. ["gymshark.com"]. Omit for all your tracked brands.

max_per_brand.description: Technologies listed per brand (default 40). The rest are counted, not listed.

tools.name: get_email_newsletter_insights
tools.description: A brand's email newsletter patterns: cadence, send times, themes and offers, from RivalSweeper's newsletter tracking.

domain.description: A brand domain from your RivalSweeper account, e.g. gymshark.com

tools.name: get_social_media_channels_and_followers
tools.description: Social network presence per brand: channels, followers and posting cadence.

domains.description: Brand domains from your RivalSweeper account, e.g. ["gymshark.com"]. Omit for all your tracked brands.

tools.name: get_competitor_moves_feed
tools.description: What your rivals changed, newest first: technology and providers, shipping, ads, marketing messages, AI citations, agent readiness, hiring, performance, bestsellers, Terms / privacy / return / shipping policy and other info page changes (type 'Content Pages', with the number of changes per page), and more (RivalSweeper's Domain Moves feed). Default last 7 days.

domains.description: Brand domains from your RivalSweeper account, e.g. ["gymshark.com"]. Omit for all your tracked brands.

tools.name: get_predicted_competitor_moves
tools.description: RivalSweeper's weekly prediction cards for each tracked rival, as on the Predictions page: what just happened, what is coming up (e.g. Black Friday on last year's timing) and where their ads outpace you. Each card has the why, a suggested move with its date, and dated proof (receipts, article links).

tools.name: get_upcoming_events_news_and_activity
tools.description: Your dashboard agenda: upcoming holidays and retail events in each brand's own market (e.g. Hanukkah for Israeli brands), with the brands each event is for, news mentions (7 days) and recent catalog activity per brand.

domains.description: Brand domains from your RivalSweeper account, e.g. ["gymshark.com"]. Omit for all your tracked brands.

tools.name: get_my_rivalsweeper_todo_list
tools.description: Action items RivalSweeper raised for your team (e.g. fix a broken ad landing page, respond to a rival promotion), with priority, status, owner and due date. Default: pending items.

tools.name: find_ads_with_broken_pages_or_expired_offers
tools.description: Ad & Deal Health, untrimmed: every live ad that points to a broken or out-of-stock page, promotes an expired offer, keeps an evergreen 'urgency' claim, or could not be checked, plus expired homepage banners, with the full ad text, links, landing check and product read. Checks your own store by default, or one named rival.

domain.description: One brand domain from your account; omit for your own store

tools.name: find_public_problems_on_my_store
tools.description: My Store Guard (beta): problems anyone can see on your own store from outside, such as ads landing on dead pages, most products out of stock, prices dropped to 0, a domain or certificate about to expire, lookalike domains, AI crawlers blocked or no robots.txt, low AI readiness and URL structure changes, each with the address, what was seen and when, and how to fix it. Based on public data: an early indicator, not a full audit. Owned store only (for rivals use find_ads_with_broken_pages_or_expired_offers). Areas: ads, pages, products, ai, trust, brand; areas we could not check are listed as not_checked, never as fine. Open issues by default; include_fixed / include_ignored add those.

domain.description: Your own store domain, if you have more than one; omit for your store. Rival domains are refused.

area.description: Only this area: ads, pages, products, ai, trust or brand. Omit for all six.

include_fixed.description: Also list issues fixed in the last 30 days (default false).

include_ignored.description: Also list issues your team ignored, with the reason (default false).

tools.name: get_discount_frequency_and_depth
tools.description: How often and how deep each brand discounts, over a window (7-365 days, default 30), from two separate readings: homepage_banner = days a promotion banner was on the brand's homepage (read from our homepage captures; 'not_measured' when we hold no capture in the window), and product_markdowns = products whose price, read in the window, is below their full price, with average and max markdown %, in one store and currency per brand, out of products_priced (every product whose price was read in the window, same store and currency), so share_on_markdown_pct is the share of the brand's catalog on markdown. Counts are products (a product's size and colour variants count once). Use share_on_markdown_pct for 'how much of the catalog is on sale'; do not divide products_on_markdown by a catalog size from another tool, which may count variant rows or another store. product_markdowns is 'not_measured' (never 0) when we have never read a crossed-out price on the brand's pages, since a sale price then looks like a regular one. A brand can run product markdowns with no homepage banner, and the reverse: when product markdowns are 0 or near 0 but the homepage advertises a discount (a cart- or collection-level sale), homepage_promo_not_on_product_prices quotes the brand's homepage line verbatim with its source and dates.

domains.description: Brand domains from your RivalSweeper account, e.g. ["gymshark.com"]. Omit for all your tracked brands.

tools.name: get_most_discounted_products
tools.description: A brand's most-discounted products right now (by % or amount) or its newest discounts, with price, full price and discount. When a brand has no (or almost no) product priced below full price but its homepage advertises a discount, homepage_promotions_not_on_product_prices quotes that homepage line verbatim with its source and dates (the discount is not on the product prices read).

tools.name: get_how_ai_models_describe_brand
tools.description: How large language models describe a brand when asked shopping questions, by aspect: brand_reputation, competitor_comparison, product_recommendation, brand_review, industry_landscape, brand_sentiment, recommendation_gap. RivalSweeper currently samples Google Gemini and OpenAI's open-weight GPT-OSS models.

domain.description: A brand domain from your RivalSweeper account, e.g. gymshark.com

tools.name: get_brand_swot_analysis
tools.description: RivalSweeper's SWOT analysis of a brand over time: strengths, weaknesses, opportunities and threats, and how they changed.

domain.description: A brand domain from your RivalSweeper account, e.g. gymshark.com

tools.name: get_homepage_analysis
tools.description: RivalSweeper's analysis of a brand's homepage: what it features and emphasizes, offers and messaging, and how it compares with rivals.

domain.description: A brand domain from your RivalSweeper account, e.g. gymshark.com

tools.name: get_product_page_analysis
tools.description: RivalSweeper's analysis of a brand's product pages: the tactics they use (content, imagery, trust signals, offers, cross-sell).

domain.description: A brand domain from your RivalSweeper account, e.g. gymshark.com

tools.name: get_catalog_analysis
tools.description: RivalSweeper's analysis of a brand's product catalog: assortment, categories and pricing structure.

domain.description: A brand domain from your RivalSweeper account, e.g. gymshark.com

tools.name: get_customer_reviews_analysis
tools.description: RivalSweeper's analysis of a brand's customer reviews: recurring themes, sentiment, praise and complaints.

domain.description: A brand domain from your RivalSweeper account, e.g. gymshark.com

tools.name: get_ai_model_citation_rate
tools.description: Whether AI models mention each brand in their answers, split by question kind: brand_named = questions that name the brand ("What do you know about X?", "Compare X with its competitors": shows whether models know the brand, not whether they recommend it unprompted) and unbranded = shopping questions that do not name it (the recommendation test). Each with rate, by model (and the platform serving it), and recent examples. Our own prompt-generation queries (keyword and shopper-question lists) are not citation tests and are left out.

domains.description: Brand domains from your RivalSweeper account, e.g. ["gymshark.com"]. Omit for all your tracked brands.

tools.name: get_ai_shopping_agent_checkout_race
tools.description: RivalSweeper's weekly race of AI shopping agents buying the same product from your store and rivals: which stores an agent could complete checkout on, where it got stuck, KPIs and findings.

tools.name: get_job_openings_and_hiring_trends
tools.description: Open roles per brand by department and location, change vs last check (change_count = roles gained or lost, change_pct = that change as a percent of the previous count), strategic hiring themes read from job titles (marketplace, AI, physical stores, new category, B2B, markets named in titles, pricing, social commerce such as TikTok Shop and live shopping) with the matching titles, top job titles and newly added or removed jobs - an early read on where a rival is investing.

domains.description: Brand domains from your RivalSweeper account, e.g. ["gymshark.com"]. Omit for all your tracked brands.

tools.name: get_where_brands_are_listed
tools.description: Websites where your store and your competitors are listed: booking platforms, marketplaces, directories, review and comparison sites. Found by weekly public web search for each site's domain, phone numbers, public email, address and name; a listing counts as confirmed only when it shows that phone, email, domain or address, and every one comes with its link and the matched text. Also returns gaps and opportunities (platforms your competitors use and you don't, and relevant platforms none of you use yet) and recent changes. "Not found" means our searches did not find it, not that it does not exist.

domains.description: Competitor domains from your RivalSweeper account to compare, up to 6 (your own site is always included). Omit for the 6 competitors with the most confirmed listings.

category.description: Only platforms of this kind: ota_booking, marketplace, app_store, directory, review, comparison, classifieds, news, social, forum, coupon, reference or other. Omit for all.
